title: Genitive relationships
subtitle: Read possession, source, and description without flattening them.
overview: A genitive marks a relationship; English “of” is a useful first gloss, not a final interpretation.
Ask what relationship makes sense here: possession, source, description, content, or something else supplied by context.

items.grc: ἡ χάρις τοῦ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ μετὰ πάντων.
items.en: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all.
